synthesis:draft.headline: Peak five-minute RRP in VIC1 was 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: Peak five-minute RRP in VIC1 was 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (UTC+1000).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND in VIC1 at that interval (interval-ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z / 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 6639.92 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, 5-minute).
There were 6 five-minute intervals at-or-above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window.
The half-hour operational demand (30-minute measured) in the half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z was 6812.0 MW, and the window's maximum operational demand was 7485.0 MW.
Dispatch NETINTERCHANGE in VIC1 at 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z / 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (UTC+1000) was -718.24 MW (net flow into VIC1).

possible_explanations.statement: A supply shortfall in scheduled generation or a change in the offer stack around 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z might be consistent with the price and demand observations; this could be tested by examining generator scheduled availability and dispatched generation changes for the intervals 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z, 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z and 2026-08-19T23:15:00Z.
